summary: TaskRabbit mutations (hire checkout, cancelTask) take their X-CSRF-Token from the URL-decoded XSRF-TOKEN cookie, falling back to a csrf-token meta tag only on older pages.
reason: The Next.js dashboard no longer renders a csrf-token meta tag, so every hire and cancel failed before reaching TaskRabbit. The site's own axios client sends the XSRF-TOKEN cookie as X-CSRF-Token.
validated_outcome: Live 2026-10-27: hire booked a real Furniture Assembly task four days out, cancel verified it left the active list, and TaskRabbit's cancellation receipt refunded the full $40.96 deposit under the 24-hour rule.
